## Summary

## Validation

- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior and failure paths.
- [ ] `npm run build` passes.
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes.
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes.
- [ ] `npm run format:check` passes.
- [ ] Relevant security and package checks pass.

## Security and compatibility

List any changes to paths, links, permissions, limits, plugins, output semantics, or public APIs.
